options.name: running_config
options.description: This option is used only with state I(parsed). The value of this option should be the output received from the NX-OS device by executing the command B(show running-config | section '^route-map'). The state I(parsed) reads the configuration from C(running_config) option and transforms it into Ansible structured data as per the resource module's argspec and the value is then returned in the I(parsed) key within the result.

options.name: state
options.description: The state the configuration should be left in. With state I(replaced), for the listed route-maps, sequences that are in running-config but not in the task are negated. With state I(overridden), all route-maps that are in running-config but not in the task are negated. Please refer to examples for more details.
